To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the effectiveness of personalized online advertising depends on the type of product advertised, the type of advertising message, and the timing of the advertisement.
the effects of online advertising are influenced by the timing of ad exposure and the content of the ad message.
the effectiveness of personalized advertising depends on the type of ad, the time of day the ad is displayed, and the website where the ad appears.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of whether and how the interplay of advertising content, timing, and location influences consumer responses.

the following questions: (i) How does the effectiveness of personalized online advertising depend on the content of ads and the content of the page on which the ads appear? (ii) How does the effect of the timing of ad exposures on ad effectiveness vary with the content of ads?
the question of how to best design a personalized advertising campaign.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effects of personalized online advertising on consumer attitudes are positive and significant.
the effectiveness of online advertising depends on the interaction of the advertising message, the timing of the message, and the context of the message.
the effectiveness of personalized ads is higher than that of nonpersonalized ads.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our study shows that the effectiveness of personalized online advertising can be enhanced by taking into account not only the content but also the time and the place of the ad.

we find evidence that the effectiveness of advertising is higher when the advertising message is more closely related to the ad format, when it is placed earlier in the sequence of ads, and when it is placed closer to the product category.
we find a positive relationship between the level of personalization and the effectiveness of online advertising.
The main takeaway from our work is that
advertisers should not be overly optimistic about the effectiveness of personalized ads.
the interplay of what, when, and where matters in personalized online advertising effectiveness.
the effectiveness of online advertising depends on the combination of the type of ad (what), the timing (when), and the placement of the ad (where).
